notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Hey, hey people!
Here's a small Halloween update for you while I'm working on the 0.2 version overhauling the gameplay.
The update adds candles and pumpkins to the level, also the antagonist joins the feast too.

notes.title: Update #8
notes.content:
[b][list]
[*]Added map (default key is TAB).
[*]Performance optimization.
[*]Reduced game size.
[*]Bug fixes.
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Update #7.1
notes.content:
[b][list]
[*]Cameras are now listed in order.
[*]Minor optimizations.
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Update #7
notes.content:
[b][list]
[*]Jerrycan will now spawn in the basement to save you some time.
[*]Minor bug fixes and gameplay rebalance.
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Update #6
notes.content:
[b][list]
[*]CCTV and flashlight now can work separately.
[*]Updated failing conditions to make more sense.
[*]Minor bug fixes and gameplay rebalance.
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
[b][list]
[*]Quality-of-life updates.
[*]Hopefully fixed the bug when the player was unable to leave a hiding place after the hunt phase. Random overlaps.
[*]New Loading, Main Menu screens.
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
[b][list]
[*]NEW: location names on the top left corner of the screen for better orientation in the area.
[*]Gameplay tweaks.
[*]Fixed reflections for flashlight.
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
[b][list]
[*]Several bug fixes.
[*]Quality-of-life updates.
[*]Corrections for Japanese, Korean and Chinese localizations.
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
[b][list]
[*]Several bug fixes.
